list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Share of commits in instrumented repositories that carry an AI-Attribution trailer of any kind, including the states meaning no evidence was available. **Coverage is not adoption** — a repository at 100% may have had no agent involvement at all. It says the instrumentation is working, nothing more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT w.commit_sha)
                    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha), 0), 1) AS coverage
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc  ON rc.commit_sha  = c.sha
JOIN repo_commits rc2 ON rc2.repo_id    = rc.repo_id
JOIN whodunit_commits seen ON seen.commit_sha = rc2.commit_sha
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.sha
WHERE c.authored_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom())
                          AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())

panels.title: Penetration
panels.description: Share of commits with a real verdict that are AI-assisted. The denominator is `assisted` + `unassisted` + `unmatched` — all three mean the tool looked and reached an answer. `uninstrumented` and `undetermined` are excluded: it never looked, so counting them would understate this. Read it beside Coverage.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: undetermined, uninstrumented, degraded
--   the tool never reached a verdict on these, so counting them
--   would understate the rate rather than complete it
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(status = 'assisted')
     / NULLIF(SUM(status IN ('assisted','unassisted','unmatched')), 0) AS penetration
FROM whodunit_commits
WHERE committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.title: Commits
panels.description: Total commits in the selected window, whether or not they carry a trailer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS commits FROM whodunit_commits WHERE committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.title: Median agent share
panels.description: Median ratio across commits that have one. Ratio is the share of a commit's changed lines matching text an agent produced — overlap, not authorship. A line the agent wrote and a developer then edited counts as the developer's. Commits with no line-level evidence are excluded, not counted as zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(t.ratio) AS median_share FROM (
  SELECT c.ratio,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.ratio) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM whodunit_commits c
  WHERE c.ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                           AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
) t
WHERE t.rn IN (FLOOR((t.n + 1) / 2), CEIL((t.n + 1) / 2))

options.content: **Coverage is the denominator for everything below.** A penetration figure without it says how much of *what we could see* was assisted, not how much of the work was. `undetermined` means no determination was made — never "no AI was used".

panels.title: Evidence mix
panels.description: How much evidence stands behind each commit, strongest first: intersected, observed, declared, inferred — then the states meaning there is none. Read it beside any penetration figure: a number resting on `declared` is a different claim from one resting on `intersected`.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: undetermined
--   the COALESCE fallback already labels it; naming it here
--   would shadow that with the raw status
SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END AS state,
       COUNT(*) AS commits
FROM whodunit_commits c
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END
ORDER BY commits DESC

panels.title: Purpose distribution
panels.description: What kind of work the commits were. Coverage without this is close to meaningless: 80% AI-assisted reads very differently when it is tests and config than when it is core feature logic.

targets.rawSql: SELECT purpose, COUNT(*) AS commits FROM whodunit_commits WHERE committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY commits DESC

panels.title: Evidence mix over time
panels.description: Commits per day by evidence state. A drop in the stronger states without a drop in commit volume usually means an adapter stopped recognising its agent's format, not that people stopped using agents.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: undetermined
--   the COALESCE fallback already labels it; naming it here
--   would shadow that with the raw status
SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(c.committed_at / 1000000000 / 86400) * 86400) AS time,
       CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY time, CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END
ORDER BY time

options.content: **Journal data, not commit data.** This records what an agent touched, including work that never reached a commit, so it will not reconcile with the panels above — and is not meant to.

panels.title: Most agent-edited files
panels.description: Per-file agent activity, from observed edits rather than commits. A file with many edits and few committed lines is one the agent iterated on heavily — that is effort, not output.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(file, '/', -1) AS file, COUNT(*) AS agent_edits, SUM(lines_added) AS lines_written FROM whodunit_events WHERE file <> '' AND observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 GROUP BY file ORDER BY agent_edits DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Agent activity by tool
panels.description: Which operations agents performed. Read alongside the commit panels: a large edit count with low committed output means iteration, not productivity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent, tool, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(lines_added) AS lines_added, SUM(lines_removed) AS lines_removed FROM whodunit_events WHERE observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 GROUP BY agent, tool ORDER BY events DESC
